messages:
Priya R: Huge shoutout to @Sam I and the infra/docs crew — the last-minute DB migration rollback you pulled off saved the client demo tonight. Seriously heroic :tada:
Ethan L: +1. That 2am surgery was clutch. Thank you all.
Sam I: Team effort — thanks for flagging the rollback window early, Priya.
Maya T: Coffee (or smoothies) on me tomorrow morning for whoever worked on this. DM me! :coffee:
Leah O: I put in an order for bagels at 8:30am in #kitchen — label: "Demo Saviors". If anyone has dietary prefs, ping me.
Priya R: Also — can someone drop the minimal command we ran here for the playbook? Putting it in the postmortem.
Sam I: Sure — the quick sequence was:
```
kubectl rollout restart deployment/demo-service -n prod
kubectl scale statefulset db-ops --replicas=0 && kubectl scale statefulset db-ops --replicas=1
# wait for ready, then reconnect proxies
```
Priya R: Adding that to the doc now. Will link the postmortem once it's up.
devex-bot: A kudos card has been created for the team (Kudos #8732) and scheduled for the next all-hands. :sparkles:
Ethan L: Also, tiny poll: Bagels or tacos for the celebratory breakfast? React with :bagel: or :taco:
Maya T: :bagel: from me
Sam I: :bagel:
Leah O: :taco: (gluten-free taco option added to the order)
Priya R: Closing poll at 7:45am. Bagels are winning so far. Thanks again everyone — saved the demo and my sleep schedule a bit. :relieved:
